assets.name: identity-studio
assets.prompt: Create an original editorial product illustration for Mindwire, a premium agent framework website. This is a tangible miniature still life, precisely art directed like a contemporary design studio's digital sculpture. Square composition. Warm chalk / ivory studio floor and seamless background (#efeee8), soft natural directional light from upper left, subtle contact shadows, restrained satin and matte materials with a little frosted acrylic. Color palette: ultramarine cobalt, pale butter yellow, burnt coral, warm ivory, graphite. Sophisticated asymmetric arrangement, realistic material detail, exceptionally clean edges. Objects occupy the central 78% with breathing space all around. Camera nearly front-facing with gentle overhead perspective, no extreme isometric view. No photographic people, robot faces, sparkle icons, glowing effects, dark tech backgrounds, cables, abstract liquid swirls, watermarks, captions or decorative typography. Only the specific simple symbols and letters requested. Render one coherent scene, not a collage or a grid. Subject: YOUR IDENTITY, represented by a compact physical brand kit. A broad ivory browser-shaped slab standing at a slight angle in back has a tiny graphite top bar and a simple original cobalt four-petal cut-paper flower emblem at top left. It contains a big black 'Aa' typography specimen and a simple cobalt rounded call-to-action block with no lettering. In front, a smaller coral-colored card bearing the same four-petal emblem in ivory partially overlaps the browser. A fan of three thick color swatches in cobalt, pale yellow and warm coral lies at lower right. Simple, memorable, visibly a brand and interface system. No laptop, no phone, no keyboard, no long UI text. Keep the shapes visually distinct and easy to understand at a 250-pixel display size.

assets.name: connection-drop
assets.prompt: Create one original sculptural water droplet as a clean isolated 3D asset for a premium agent framework website. True transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text or other objects. A single gently asymmetric upright teardrop, slender curved tip and a beautifully rounded full lower body, like a drop of thick satin liquid suspended in air. Material is luminous polished ultramarine cobalt with subtle violet through the middle and a warm amber-coral reflection along the right lower edge, a thin ivory highlight along the curved left edge. Physically convincing surface and depth, refined soft studio reflections, no plastic cartoon appearance, no noisy marbling, no sparkle icons, no surrounding droplets. The droplet occupies 76% of a square canvas with ample transparent margin, upright, elegant and richly tactile.
